recognize_zh: 單一嗜酸性球，核呈 C 形/帶狀的低分葉，細胞質內橘紅色顆粒分布不均並有部分脫顆粒的淡染區與小空泡；這種型態異常的嗜酸性球是 PCM1::JAK2 相關嗜酸性球增多的線索之一，但本身不具特異性。
features: Orange-red eosinophilic granules unevenly distributed with areas of partial degranulation
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis including occasional ovalocytes and a teardrop-like form
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an eosinophil with a hypolobated band-form (C-shaped) nucleus and unevenly distributed eosinophilic granules with areas of degranulation and small cytoplasmic vacuoles. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional ovalocytes and a teardrop-like cell. Dysplastic features in eosinophils are nonspecific and may occur in reactive states. In the setting of a documented PCM1::JAK2 fusion, the abnormal eosinophil is consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and JAK2 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils can also be vacuolated or degranulated, so a clonal process requires cytogenetic/molecular evidence rather than morphology alone.
CEL shows similar dysplastic eosinophils but requires clonality or increased blasts without a defining PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangement.
Morphologically indistinguishable in blood; FIP1L1::PDGFRA is detected by FISH or RT-PCR and predicts imatinib response.
Immature forms have mixed basophilic-staining granules and rounder or kidney-shaped nuclei with more cytoplasmic basophilia.
